title: Alignment Beacons and Dependency Signals for Roadmap Cutovers
creator: Aria Walker
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable system of 'alignment beacons'—explicit readiness signals emitted by Eng/Design/Security/Infra teams to mark dependency readiness for roadmap cutovers. The goal is a low-friction signal set (boolean + short payload) that can be surfaced in the Console roadmap view and trigger automated escalation if a critical beacon does not transition to green within defined windows.
acceptance_criteria: Definition doc for 5 standard beacon types (API, UI, Infra, Security, Compliance) approved by Eng/Design/Security leads
Beacon schema and minimal payload (status, timestamp, owner, short note, link-to-artifact) implemented as a small webhook endpoint and a Console ingest path
Console roadmap overlay shows beacon states per initiative and highlights blockers with one-click escalation that creates a prefilled Slack thread and a Linear blocker ticket
Automated canary: simulate a delayed beacon for a test initiative and validate escalation flow (notification + ticket + 30m SLA for owner ack)
Playbook documented with owner rotations and post-mortem template for missed beacons
tasks: Finalize beacon types and payload fields (1 day) - PM lead
Proto webhook endpoint + small consumer in Console (Eng)
Design micro UI for roadmap overlay and quick-escalate UX (Design)
Integrate with on-call rotations and escalation Slack channel (Infra)
QA: end-to-end test using a synthetic initiative and simulated delays
notes: This ticket focuses on signal harmonization rather than heavy automation. Keep beacon payload intentionally small to encourage adoption. We will iterate on richer telemetry once adoption reaches 50% of cross-team initiatives.

2025-03-04: Agreed to add 'degraded' state and TTL to reduce noise - accepted by PM and Eng.

rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot): 3 initiatives in April with Eng+Design+Security leads participating. Phase 2 (wider adoption): automatically enable beacons for all initiatives created in Cycle 2025-W14; include onboarding docs and 1-hour office hours sessions.
risks: Adoption risk: teams may not emit beacons leading to false negatives - mitigation: light-weight SDK and example scripts in multiple languages
Noise risk: infra flaps could produce degraded signals - mitigation: TTL and repeated-report suppression
Security risk: webhook auth for Dedicated customers adds complexity - mitigation: provide a simple SaaS token path for hosted customers and mutual TLS guidance for Dedicated
